1473526034276438017.a: Confusion: Consider that ~70,000 years ago Neanderthals (people from above) hybridized with other Human-like species in an effort to avoid extinction caused by climate change. This we know from DNA sequencing of people who died in caves through the recent ancient past (<250kya).

1473527060102533123.a: The result of these hybridizations were almost certainly many bloodlines that had varying degrees of hybridization. Inter-species breeding normally results in genetically corrupted, sterile offspring if not a miscarriage. Some bloodlines would have been more fragile than others.

1473527062120046597.a: Those fragile bloodlines likely would have had to inbreed with themselves in a controlled manner to avoid extinction.

1473531526461673477.a: 1/ His terrible explanation of airport RADAR is worth paying attention to if you want to understand why it's useless for detecting things that are not airport. Basically, most people think RADAR works by reflecting off the metal of the (space/)aircraft. No. Not at all today.

1473531527724257286.a: 2/ Flying craft have transponders on them to detect the RADAR sweep and send out a Mode S (S Band) data packet for the RADAR dish to receive telling the system who and where it is. Turn off transponder and you are effectively invisible to RADAR. If you are big you will reflect.🛸

1473532731091034115.a: 3/ Somewhat related is that spacecraft in orbit are required to carry a ~200 MHz (VHF) passive reflector or transponder on them in order to tell military RADAR it's not an ICBM or meteor or something unexpected. It also helps generate Keplerian elements to some extent AFAIK.

1473537380879642628.a: Caveat: I haven't messed with aircraft RADAR since the 90s so things may have changed a bit or my memory might be fuzzy. I have rebuilt decommissioned military RADAR systems which were brought into civilian use. You could pickup RADAR systems from Wright Pat. auctions in the 90s.
